exposure: gestational age at preterm premature rupture of membranes
preterm premature rupture of membranes at 22-25 weeks' gestation
outcome: survival at discharge without severe morbidity
survival at 2 years' corrected age without cerebral palsy
cohort: 379 women diagnosed with preterm premature rupture of membranes at 22-25 weeks' gestation from the EPIPAGE-2 cohort (a French national prospective population-based cohort of preterm infants born in 2011)
finding: Preterm premature rupture of membranes at 22-25 weeks' gestation was associated with a high incidence of mortality and morbidity, with a wide variation in outcomes depending on gestational age at rupture.
